data_a.situation: A client date on job QM-2031-0519 moved and the coordinator heard about it from the client's side rather than from the workroom.
known_facts: The Marchmont Enclosure date on QM-2031-0519 moved forward to Wednesday 15 October.
The coordinator heard about the change from the client's assistant, not from the workroom.
The workroom manager agreed the new date with Marchmont on Monday 6 October.
The new date adds two steam cycles to an annexe schedule with one free press.
Nobody has yet worked out which pieces the two extra cycles displace.
constraints: Client dates are agreed by the workroom manager.
Schedule impact is put to the workroom manager in writing.
The coordinator sets the order of work inside the annexe.
